title: The Mystery Chess Book
body: Over five hundred years ago, someone wrote a secret handbook of chess strategies called the Göttingen manuscript. Some historians believe it was created for a young Spanish prince, while others think it was written in Portugal. To this day, nobody knows for sure who actually wrote down these very first modern chess secrets!

variants.lucy: Imagine holding a delicate, hand-written book that is over five hundred years old. Its pages whisper secrets about how to move the chess pieces in brand new ways. Some people believe a teacher crafted this guide especially for a young prince in Spain.
variants.luca: This was the ultimate secret handbook of its time, packed with clever plans! We still do not know if it was written in Portugal or made for a royal Spanish family. The author left no name, leaving us with a brilliant chess mystery that nobody has solved yet.
variants.cn: 想象一下，你手里捧着一本五百多岁、薄薄的手写小书。它的书页轻声细语，讲着用全新方法移动棋子的秘密。有人相信，这本小书是一位老师特意为西班牙的一位小王子写的呢。

source.book: The Art of the Game of Chess
source.author: Ruy López, trans. Andrew Soltis & Michael J. McGrath
